雅思早间任务 · 第 5 周第 3 天（11 月 20 日 周五）

点单词卡任意位置播放英音。点中文可以单独显示或隐藏，也可以用按钮一键切换全部。

强化期第 3 天。今天的主题是订酒店和公共设施：酒店位置、设施、翻新、口碑，还有图书馆里的各个区域和「在哪儿」的方位说法。这是 Part 1 和 Part 2 的经典场景，去澳洲找住处、办图书卡、问路都用得上。卡片里「≈」后面是同义替换，背的时候连同替换说法一起读出来。

例句

  • The hotel is in a rural area. = It's out in the country.（这家酒店在乡下。）
  • It was refurbished last year. = It was completely done up last year.（去年彻底翻新过。）
  • It only opened recently. = It took its first guests just a few months ago.（它刚开业不久。）
  • The hotel has facilities for business functions. = It has meeting rooms for corporate events.（酒店有办商务活动的设施。）
  • The café is opposite the bank. = The café is across from the bank.（咖啡馆在银行对面。）
  • You can borrow DVDs here. = You can take out DVDs here.（这里可以借 DVD。）

过关标准：遮住中文看英文，能说出 22 个以上的意思，而且每个词至少能说出一个同义替换。再挑 5 个造句，把同一句话用两种说法各说一遍。

听力（30 分钟）

听前生词（先过一遍再听）

这集里四级以外的难词，点卡片听发音，点中文自测。原文里这些词也标了虚线，点一下就显示中文。

  • 🔊 possibility可能的选择点击显示
  • 🔊 character特色，个性点击显示
  • 🔊 chain连锁（店）点击显示
  • 🔊 gym健身房点击显示
  • 🔊 fitness健身点击显示
  • 🔊 librarian图书管理员点击显示
  • 🔊 organize安排，布置点击显示
  • 🔊 photocopier复印机点击显示
  • 🔊 non-fiction纪实类作品点击显示
  • 🔊 seminar研讨会点击显示
  • 🔊 multimedia多媒体点击显示

今天用的是雅思官方样题（ielts.org 官方 Sample tasks）的最后两段：一段 Part 1 配对题（游客中心工作人员介绍五家酒店，约 2 分钟），一段 Part 2 平面图题（图书馆馆长带大家认识各个区域，约 3 分钟）。地图题是很多人的弱项，今天重点练「跟着方位词在图上走」。音频、题目和平面图都放在页面里了。

  1. 先把上面的听前生词过一遍，听不太懂可以先读懂原文再听。再把下面「方位词小抄」读两遍。
  2. 按考试方式做一遍：每段先花 30 秒看题，配对题先把五个酒店名字读熟；地图题先找到入口，在图上标出左右。然后只听一遍，边听边做，不暂停。做完点「对答案」。
  3. 第二遍精听：红色的题先别看答案，再听一遍那段，实在听不出来再点开原文找。
  4. 第三遍对原文：对照下面「同义替换和陷阱」，在原文里看粗体的地方。配对题的难点是录音里一次说好几家酒店，还有干扰（Royal Oak 也有泳池，但是室外的）。
  5. 最后挑馆长第二段（"Well, as you see my desk is just on your right..."）跟读一遍，模仿语气和重音。

方位词小抄（地图题必备）

  • on your right / left as you go in　进门后在你右/左手边
  • opposite (this)　在（这个的）对面
  • just beyond / just past ...　刚过了……再往前一点
  • carry straight on / go straight ahead　一直往前走
  • on the far wall / through the far door　最里面那面墙 / 最里面那扇门
  • next door to ...　在……隔壁
  • to the right of ... / on the left of ...　在……右边 / 左边
  • in the corner / at the end of the corridor　在角落 / 在走廊尽头

11 　12 　13 　14 　15

今天录音里的同义替换和陷阱（题目 → 录音）

  • is in a rural area → out in the country, about ten kilometres away
  • only opened recently → took their first guests just a few months ago（old building 是干扰，楼老但开业新）
  • facilities for business functions → meetings rooms ... used for conferences and corporate events
  • has an indoor swimming pool → the only hotel with an indoor pool is the Bridge Hotel（Royal Oak 是 outdoor pool；Majestic 还在 planning，没建好）
  • Reference books (H) → opposite this the first room on your left has ... reference books
  • Periodicals (G) → just beyond the librarian's desk ... periodicals such as newspapers and magazines
  • Local history collection (D) → on the far wall ... books relating to local history（Tourist information 只是 hoping to add，是干扰项）
  • Children's books (B) → next door to the seminar room is the children's library
  • Multimedia (F) → a large room to the right of the library area（Art collection 是 originally，已经搬走，干扰项）

录音 1：游客中心选酒店（Part 1，Q1–4）

Official：Can I help you?

Official：您好，需要帮忙吗？

Man：Yes, I was wanting somewhere to stay for a few days - a four- or five-star hotel. Can you tell me something about the possibilities可能的选择?

Man：是的，我想找个地方住几天，四星或五星酒店。能给我介绍一下有哪些选择吗？

Official：OK, right, well there are five hotels that might interest you. Were you wanting a city centre location, or would you be interested in something a bit further out稍微远一点?

Official：好的，有五家酒店您可能会感兴趣。您是想住市中心，还是稍微远一点的地方也可以？

Man：Well, I do have a car so I could go for either哪个都行.

Man：嗯，我有车，所以哪种都行。

Official：Well, there are two central hotels in the range在（价格/档次）范围内 you're looking for – there's Carlton House and The Imperial, they're both near the main square, but if you've got your own transport you might be interested in the Royal Oak – that's out in the country在乡下, about ten kilometres away, very peaceful. Then there's the Bridge hotel and the Majestic – they're both in town but not in the centre, they're out on the airport road.

Official：在您要的这个档次里，市中心有两家：Carlton House 和 The Imperial，都在主广场附近。不过既然您自己有车，可能会对 Royal Oak 感兴趣，它在乡下，大概十公里外，非常安静。还有 Bridge 酒店和 Majestic，它们都在城里但不在中心，在去机场的那条路上。

Man：Mmm that might be a bit far out actually. OK, now the other two you mentioned, in the city centre. Can you tell me a bit about them?

Man：嗯，那可能有点太远了。好，你刚才说的市中心那两家，能介绍一下吗？

Official：Well, they're both excellent hotels. If you want something with a bit of character有点特色, Carlton House is quite unusual – it's a very old building that was originally a large private house. It was bought by the Vannis chain连锁（店） and they completely refurbished翻新 it – they took their first guests开始接待第一批客人 just a few months ago but it's already got an excellent reputation名声，口碑. That's a five-star hotel. Or there's the Imperial, which is a much more modern building. That also has its own gym健身房 and it also has internet connection and meetings rooms – it's used for conferences会议 and corporate events公司活动 as well as以及，除了……还 private guests. That's five-star as well.

Official：两家都很好。如果您想要有点特色的，Carlton House 很特别，是一栋很老的建筑，原来是一座大型私人宅邸。Vannis 连锁集团把它买下来，彻底翻新了一遍，几个月前才开始接待第一批客人，但已经口碑很好了。那是五星酒店。另一家是 The Imperial，楼要现代得多。它有自己的健身房，还有网络和会议室，除了接待个人客人，也用来办会议和公司活动。它也是五星。

Man：Does it have a swimming pool as well as以及，除了……还 a gym健身房?

Man：它除了健身房还有游泳池吗？

Official：No – the Royal Oak has an outdoor pool, which is lovely in the summer, but the only hotel with an indoor pool is the Bridge Hotel. It doesn't have a gym健身房 though. The Majestic is planning to build a swimming pool and a fitness健身 centre, but it's not finished yet.

Official：没有。Royal Oak 有个室外泳池，夏天很不错，但唯一有室内泳池的是 Bridge 酒店，不过它没有健身房。Majestic 正打算建一个游泳池和一个健身中心，但还没建好。

Man：I see. Well, I think I'll probably go for one of the city centre hotels.

Man：明白了。我想我大概会选市中心的一家。

Ann（图书馆馆长）：好，各位。我们现在就在镇图书馆的入口。我叫 Ann，是这里的馆长，平时我就在正门旁边的那张服务台。我想给大家简单介绍一下图书馆是怎么布置的，什么东西在哪里……大家手里应该都有一张平面图。

Ann（图书馆馆长）：Well, as you see my desk is just on your right as you go in, and opposite this the first room on your left has an excellent collection of reference参考，工具书 books and is also a place where people can read or study peacefully. Ann（图书馆馆长）：If you carry straight on一直往前走 you'll come into a large room and this is the main library area. There is fiction小说 in the shelves on the left, and non-fiction纪实类作品 materials on your right, and on the shelves on the far wall最里面那面墙 there is an excellent collection of books relating to有关……的 local history. Ann（图书馆馆长）：一直往前走，就会进到一个大房间，这是图书馆的主区。左边书架上是小说，右边是非虚构类资料，最里面那面墙的书架上，有一批很好的本地历史书。我们还希望今年晚些时候再加一个本地旅游景点的专区。

Ann（图书馆馆长）：Through the far door in the library just past the fiction小说 shelves is a seminar研讨会 room, and that can be booked for meetings or talks, and next door to在……隔壁 that is the children's library, which has a good collection of stories and picture books for the under elevens11 岁以下的孩子. Then there's a large room to the right of the library area – that's the multimedia多媒体 collection, where you can borrow videos and DVDs and so on等等, and we also have CD-Roms you can borrow to use on your computer at home. It was originally the art collection but that's been moved to another building. And that's about it大概就这些 – oh, there's also the Library Office, on the left of the librarian图书管理员's desk. OK, now does anyone have any questions?

Ann（图书馆馆长）：穿过主区里那扇、就在小说书架过去一点的远处的门，是一间研讨室，可以预订来开会或办讲座；它隔壁是儿童图书馆，有很多给 11 岁以下孩子看的故事书和绘本。然后主区右边有个大房间，是多媒体资料室，可以借录像带、DVD 之类的，还有 CD-ROM，可以借回家在电脑上用。那里原来是艺术收藏室，不过艺术收藏已经搬到另一栋楼了。大概就这些。哦，还有图书馆办公室，在服务台的左边。好，大家有什么问题吗？

1 E　2 B　3 C　4 A

11 H　12 G　13 D　14 B　15 F

常见失分点：Q2 别因为听到 very old building 就排除 Carlton House，问的是开业时间不是楼龄；Q4 听到 Royal Oak has an outdoor pool 就选 E 是上当，后面 but the only hotel with an indoor pool 才是答案；地图题里 A Art collection、I Tourist information、C Computers、E Meeting room 都没对上（seminar room 图上已经标了），提到 originally、hoping to、planning to 的通常是「现在没有」。

过关标准：两段一共 9 题，第一遍对 7 题以上就算达标；第二遍要弄清每道错题错在哪：没听到、被干扰项带跑、方位没跟上，还是同义替换没反应过来。

小练习（同义替换）

  1. The hotel was completely ______ up last year.（= refurbished）
  2. It's a quiet hotel ______ in the country.（= rural）
  3. The bank is ______ from the post office.（= opposite）
  4. You can take ______ up to six books.（= borrow）
  5. I'd like to ______ a room for Friday night.（= reserve）
  6. The hall is used for business ______ and weddings.（= events）
点开看答案

1. done　2. out　3. across　4. out　5. book　6. functions

今天的小思考（为口语 Part 1 做准备）：Do you often go to the library? 用英语说两三句：I used to go ... / Nowadays I mostly ... because ...。再用今天的方位词，描述一下你家或公司附近一个地方怎么走：Go straight on, it's opposite the ... / just past the ...。
